_README: OPTIONAL / REFERENCE ONLY. This is a Keycloak realm-import document that wires an LDAP user-federation provider pointing at the CCDC Active Directory domain (prccdc.local) via the svc_ldap bind account. It is NOT applied automatically by the ccdc_sso role and does not need to succeed at deploy. To use it, either import it from the Keycloak admin console (Realm settings > Partial import) or restart Keycloak with the arg '--import-realm' and this file placed in /opt/keycloak/data/import. Replace BIND_PASSWORD_HERE and adjust the connectionUrl / DNs to match your range before importing.
_NOTES: Standard JSON has no comment syntax; the human notes live in these _README/_NOTES fields, which Keycloak ignores on import.
editMode READ_ONLY keeps Keycloak from writing back to AD - safest for a lab. Use WRITABLE only if you want Keycloak to manage AD accounts.
vendor 'ad' selects Active-Directory-specific defaults (objectGUID as UUID, sAMAccountName as username, memberOf group handling).
connectionUrl uses the DC by hostname; prefer dc01.prccdc.local (or ldaps://... on 636 with a trusted cert) over a hard-coded IP.
bindDn svc_ldap is created on the DC by the ccdc_ad_accounts role; supply its password out-of-band, do not commit it.
